title: Hanasato Minori — Watching Her Back〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, there's the bell. I guess it's time for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we got here sooner than expected. I'm glad that we were able to wrap things up at work so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should be able to take our time and enjoy our lunches. How about we head over to the courtyard...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!
Oh, Minori! Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane! Oh, Ichika and Honami are with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning. All finished with work? You must be tired.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Were you three about to have lunch together as well?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We were thinking about buying something at the school store and sitting in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! We were just about to put our bags away and head over to the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we all have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What are you guys doing all gathered up?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, good timing.
Would you like to do the honors, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, lemme invite them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saki! You guys! Do you have plans for where you're eating lunch?
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so great to be able to have lunch together like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm also really glad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, can I ask you guys about the credit-based course? What's it like?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh... I sorta can't make any conclusions yet since the new term just started...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But there's definitely a ton of famous people.
Like models, streamers and all sorts of other celebrities!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, do they also juggle school with work?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup. They'll work in the morning and come to school in the afternoon, or come just for the morning and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
That's amazing how they can stay on top of everything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! That's why I feel I also need to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, how about you guys?
Have things changed for you in second year?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Outside of our new classes, it pretty much comes down to new textbooks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm sure everyone in the credit-based course uses the same textbooks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, they should be the same.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, how about your teachers?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hardly anything's changed.
We basically get the same lineup from last year.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
We also have pretty much the same teachers as last year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?! I always thought the credit-based course was like another world! I guess that isn't the case, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our textbooks are the same, and so are the teachers. I'm pretty relieved.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Relieved?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. By how we all still get to be a part of the same school!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. We're all still Miya Girls students.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Us having lunch together like this is proof of that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Our life as students in the credit-based course just started, and we'll probably be really busy with work in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I still get to hang out with all my friends!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's also why I need to do my best while I'm credit-based! I can't let their support go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Okay! I'll start by giving my afternoon classes everything I have!)
